executive_summary:
This episode centers on Candace's exclusive report that Tyler Robinson drove approximately three hours from Orem, Utah to Panguitch, Utah on the night of September 10, dined alone at the Cowboys Smokehouse bar on North Main Street, and was later verified via server identification and credit card receipt several days after his arrest. Candace argues this timeline undercuts the FBI's narrative of a tight post-shooting investigation and demands follow-up interviews at the restaurant.

The episode also revisits the Fort Huachuca storyline: Candace reports that she personally reviewed a 12-hour House committee video and now concludes Rep. Mark Amodei's alibi "checks out." New artifact-anchored evidence is presented on the Farnsworth political network – a 2014 Arizona House record linking Senator David Farnsworth and Eddie Farnsworth to Lori Frantzve on EMP legislation – along with a CBS News article on Fort Huachuca civilian leader David Frodsham and a Davis-Monthan AFB website announcement of a September 9 Commanders Summit.

Secondary segments include Candace's claims about Tyler Bowyer's deep family ties to the Farnsworths, the Daily Wire's new "Maddie in the No" show (with clip evidence), and the Brigitte Macron sentencing in France. Structurally, the episode expands the Arizona political-military network map and surfaces several new people and verification targets.

claims.label: Host Says Tyler Robinson Visited Panguitch
claims.claim: The host says Tyler Robinson drove approximately three hours from Orem, Utah to Panguitch, Utah on the night of September 10 and dined alone at the Cowboys Smokehouse bar on North Main Street.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Cowboys Smokehouse receipt and credit card statement directly; verify transaction timestamp and route.

claims.label: Cowboys Smokehouse Verified Robinson's Presence via Credit Card
claims.claim: The host says Cowboys Smokehouse staff identified Tyler Robinson from the suspect photo shared after his capture, verified his prior presence via credit card receipt, and contacted federal authorities days later, and that the feds only called them back and conducted no follow-up investigation at the restaurant.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm whether FBI / Utah officials interviewed Cowboys Smokehouse staff; obtain contemporaneous staff statement; check federal investigation logs.

claims.label: TPUSA Tent Was Group Decision
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point USA asked her to clarify that the tent at AmeriFest was initially proposed by Elizabeth McCoy but was ultimately a group decision between the events team and exhibitor hall team.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain direct TPUSA statement or correspondence clarifying the tent decision-making process.

claims.label: Erika's First September 8 Text Had Blocked Contact Name
claims.claim: The host says Erika's first text purportedly showing a conversation with Charlie Kirk about dinner on September 8 had the contact name blocked/redacted in the screenshot (sent to host December 28).
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original redacted screenshot from Erika; press for unredacted version showing contact number.

claims.label: Erika's Follow-Up Text Was a Charlie Kirk Contact Card
claims.claim: The host says that after her repeated requests to unblock the contact name, Erika's follow-up text provided a Charlie Kirk contact card image rather than the unredacted conversation screenshot.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify whether Erika retains the original unredacted text; obtain direct screen capture with contact number visible.

claims.label: Candace Concluded Mark Amodei Appears Early in 12-Hour Committee Footage
claims.claim: After personally reviewing a 12-hour House committee video, host concludes that Rep. Mark Amodei likely appears on screen early in the hearing, before the recorded roll calls, and that she thinks his story checks out.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain official House attendance record; verify timestamped committee video metadata; corroborate with eyewitness accounts.

claims.label: Tyler Bowyer Memorial Claim About Erika
claims.claim: In a clip from Charlie Kirk's memorial that the host plays, Tyler Bowyer says Erika Kirk called him saying she just wanted to help and that he put her right behind the president at the 2015 Arizona Trump rally.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check rally attendee list and corroborate timing of Erika's political involvement; verify Bowyer's narrative against other contemporaneous accounts.

claims.label: Host Says 2014 Arizona House Record Connects Farnsworths to Lori Frantzve
claims.claim: Per a 2014 Arizona House record the host shows, Senator David Farnsworth introduced Lori Frantzve, then-CEO of GTech Industries, on EMP legislation, with Eddie Farnsworth listed among voting members present and Larry Guinta also named.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the Arizona House record directly; check whether any DoD contracts to GTech Industries followed; trace GTech Industries' successor entities (AZ Tech / E3 Tech mentioned in comments at 01:04:30).

claims.label: CBS News Reported David Frodsham Returned to Fort Huachuca
claims.claim: A CBS News article reports that David Frodsham, a top civilian leader at a US air base in Afghanistan who led a child pornography ring, returned to Fort Huachuca after leaving his post.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full CBS News article and any follow-up reporting; verify Rodsham's Fort Huachuca tenure dates; check overlap with relevant September 10 events.

claims.label: Host Cites Davis-Monthan AFB Website Saying Arizona Commanders Summit Kicked Off on September 9
claims.claim: Per the Davis-Monthan AFB website the host shows, the Arizona Commanders Summit kicked off on September 9, 2025, providing a forum for military commanders and Arizona community leaders.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain attendee list for the summit; cross-check against names of interest (Farnsworths, Boyers, Erika Kirk, etc.); verify any overlap with Fort Huachuca personnel.

claims.label: Daily Wire's "Maddie in the No" Show Mocks Candace
claims.claim: The host says Daily Wire has launched a show hosted by "Maddie" designed to mock her and Tucker Carlson, and plays a clip in which the show dramatizes her Utah state flag remarks.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm show title, launch date, host identity, and episode count directly via Daily Wire's official channels.

claims.label: Charlie Back Still Image Shows No Visible Blood
claims.claim: A still image drawn from a longer video of Charlie Kirk from behind shows his St. Michael pendant chain with no visible blood on his back; host concludes this is inconsistent with a through-and-through bullet trajectory.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain unaltered full video from original source; have independent forensic analysts assess whether the absence of visible blood is consistent with the stated wound trajectory.

claims.label: Host Says Tyler Robinson Worked at Wild Electric in Santa Clara, Utah
claims.claim: The host says Tyler Robinson was employed at Wild Electric in Santa Clara, Utah, adding that she did not break this story and that it was already in the news prior to this episode.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm employment dates and identify workplace contacts relevant to the investigation timeline.

claims.label: Host says she believes the feds are colluding to introduce new speech laws
claims.claim: Presenting the French "moral damages" ruling and the Macron lawsuit against her in Delaware, the host says she believes the feds are colluding because they want to introduce new speech laws in the US and make people fearful to tell the truth.
claims.investigative_direction: Follow the Delaware docket filings in the Macron suit; track any proposed federal or state speech legislation the host links to it.
claims.transcript_snippet: I believe that the feds are colluding because they want to introduce new speech laws in this country

claims.label: Host Says Robinson Had No Prior Arrests and a Perfect ACT Score
claims.claim: The host, framing a hypothetical Netflix series about a 19-year-old protagonist who becomes a murderer, says he had never been arrested, had never committed any crimes and has a perfect ACT score, a setup she maps onto Tyler Robinson.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain court and school records on Robinson's criminal history and ACT score to confirm or refute the host's description.
claims.transcript_snippet: Uh he'd never been arrested, had never committed any crimes. He has a perfect ACT score

claims.label: Host Recounts Official Account of Robinson Eating at Dairy Queen and Texting After the Shooting
claims.claim: The host, repeatedly hedging with 'allegedly', says the official account has Robinson stopping at a nearby Dairy Queen for a calm lunch and texting his partner right after the shooting.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the Dairy Queen transaction and camera records and the charging document's description of the post-shooting texts.
claims.transcript_snippet: not exactly pop over to a nearby Dairy Queen to have lunch, calmly, have lunch, and just begin texting his lover.

claims.label: Host Says Robinson Ordered Steak With Mashed Potatoes and Vegetables and Three Servers Worked That Night
claims.claim: The host says Robinson ordered a medium-rare steak with mashed potatoes and vegetables at the Cowboys Smokehouse bar and that three servers were working that night.
claims.investigative_direction: Interview the three servers and obtain the itemised receipt and the restaurant's staffing roster for the night.
claims.transcript_snippet: Tyler Robinson ordered a steak medium rare with mashed potatoes and vegetables. There were three servers that were working that night.

claims.label: Host Says the Restaurant Has No Cameras so Staff Used Credit Card Records
claims.claim: The host says the Panguitch restaurant has no cameras, so staff could not check footage and instead looked through credit card charges to verify that Robinson had been in the building.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm with the restaurant and neighbouring businesses that no camera covered the bar or entrance on September 10, and obtain the card transaction record.
claims.transcript_snippet: they don't have any cameras at this restaurant. So, what they decided to do was to verify that he was in the building

claims.label: Host Quotes Robinson Message About Photographing and Destroying the Letter
claims.claim: The host recites a message attributed to Robinson telling his roommate to delete the letter under the keyboard, but to photograph it first and then read it and destroy it.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the host's recitation with the text messages released in the charging documents.
claims.transcript_snippet: Will make sure you delete this letter that's under the keyboard, but take a picture of it before you delete it, but read it and then destroy it.

claims.label: Host Says the Feds Did Not Check Credit Card Charges and Were Called Days Later
claims.claim: The host says she would have expected investigators to check Robinson's credit card charges after the arrest, but the federal government did not and was instead contacted days later by the restaurant, which filed a report with the receipt.
claims.investigative_direction: Request the FBI's tip log and any record of when and how it learned of the Panguitch purchase.
claims.transcript_snippet: They didn't do that. Instead, they were contacted days later um by this restaurant.

claims.label: Host Relays Robinson Was Quiet, Calm and Texting at the Restaurant
claims.claim: Relaying what the people who reported it told her, the host says Robinson was not very talkative, seemed fine and normal and was texting on his phone; she adds that he was calm, without jitters, and not scared.
claims.investigative_direction: Interview the servers directly about Robinson's demeanor and obtain the phone records for his texting that evening.
claims.transcript_snippet: He seemed absolutely fine and normal and was texting on his phone.

claims.label: Host Says She Spoke With a Lawyer She Takes to Be Erika Kirk's Lawyer
claims.claim: The host says she previously spoke with a lawyer whom she takes to be Erika Kirk's lawyer because Erika is listed as the victim, and that the lawyer said investigators separate from Erika are supposed to gather information to prove Robinson is the shooter and acted alone.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the lawyer and the date of the call; ask Erika Kirk's representatives to confirm the conversation.
claims.transcript_snippet: Now, remember I told you guys that I spoke with the lawyer. Um, this would obviously be Erika's lawyer because she's listed as the victim.

claims.label: Host Says the Dairy Queen Stop Must Have Occurred Earlier Than Documented
claims.claim: The host says the Dairy Queen stop had to occur earlier than her earlier timeline documented because a three-hour drive to Panguitch with an evening arrival leaves no room for the old timing.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the Dairy Queen transaction time, any camera timestamps and the photo metadata to fix the real time of the stop.
claims.transcript_snippet: the Dairy Queen stop because it had to have occurred earlier than we had initially documented.

claims.label: Host Says the FBI Knows of the Receipt and Has It
claims.claim: The host says there is a literal receipt from the Panguitch restaurant and that the FBI knows about it and has it in its possession.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the FBI and the restaurant whether the receipt was handed over and on what date.
claims.transcript_snippet: there was a literal receipt and the FBI knows about it um and has that in their possession.

claims.label: Host Timeline Has the 5:30 Press Conference and Patel's 5:59 Tweet That the Subject Was Released
claims.claim: In her updated timeline the host places a press conference at 5:30 and, at 5:59, a Kash Patel tweet saying the subject in custody had been released after an earlier erroneous tweet that they had him, with the investigation continuing.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the original Patel posts with their timestamps and compare with the host's 5:30 and 5:59 figures.
claims.transcript_snippet: We have that press conference that happens at 5:30. At 559, Kash Patel tweets that the subject erroneously tweets the subject in custody has been uh released

claims.label: Host Dates the First Robinson-Lance Correspondence to After 6:00 p.m.
claims.claim: The host says the first correspondence between Robinson and Lance is gauged, from their conversation, to have taken place after 6:00 p.m.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the host's 6:00 p.m. estimate with the message timestamps in the released Robinson-Lance chain.
claims.transcript_snippet: After 6:00 p. m. is when we are gauging the first correspondence to have taken place between Tyler and Lance

claims.label: Host Floats That the 6:38 Dairy Queen Photo Might Be 5:38 With a Time Zone Error
claims.claim: The host says the Dairy Queen photo was initially placed at 6:38 p.m. and wonders whether it was actually 5:38 p.m. and a time zone was wrong, promising to follow up.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original photo's metadata and the Dairy Queen's transaction logs to resolve the time zone question.
claims.transcript_snippet: Maybe it was actually 5:38 p. m. and time zones were wrong.

claims.label: Host Says Robinson Arrived in Panguitch About 8:45 p.m. and Left About 9:30 p.m.
claims.claim: The host says Robinson turned up in Panguitch at approximately 8:45 p.m., ate at the bar counter and left around 9:30 p.m.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the card transaction time and the server's account to confirm arrival and departure times.
claims.transcript_snippet: That's the time approximately that Tyler turned up in Panguitch, Utah. Again, that is 3 hours away from Orum. He has a meal at the bar counter and then he leaves around 9:30 p. m.

claims.label: Host Reports Tipsters Suspect Robinson Went to His Grandmother's House Afterwards
claims.claim: The host says the people who reported the story suspect Robinson may have gone to his grandmother's house, who is from the area and lives nearby, afterwards; she stresses this is not known as fact.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the grandmother's residence and whether anyone saw Robinson or a vehicle there on the night of September 10.
claims.transcript_snippet: he may have gone to his grandma's house afterwards because apparently that's where his grandmother is from and she lives nearby.

claims.label: Host Recalls Grandmother Said the Authorities Had the Wrong Person
claims.claim: The host recalls that Robinson's grandmother was one of the first people to speak out and said, 'You have the wrong person.'
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the grandmother's original public statement and its date and venue.
claims.transcript_snippet: Tyler Robinson's grandmother was one of the first people to speak out and she said, "You have the wrong person."

claims.label: Host Asks Businesses Near the Smokehouse to Email Tips
